cohorts.description: A json object with key-value pairs corresponding to cohorts and their values assigned to the current user for all the currently active experiments.

analytics_plan_code.description: An account description to include with analytics events.

category.description: An enum indicating the type of account. One of: "adobeid" (type 1), "enterprise" (type 2) or "federated" (type 3) or "business" (type 2e).

country_code.description: The country associated with this user.

email.description: Email address registered with this user.

first_name.description: A first name associated with this user.

first_time.description: A map of first-time indicators. e.g. dex_web_app. In the case of dex_web_app, this value will be true if they have never visited cloud.acrobat.com.

language.description: The language chosen for communication with this user.

last_name.description: A last name / family name associated with this user.

mrkt_perm_email.description: If true, the user has chosen to accept marketing material vie e-mail.

user_uri.description: The URI used to access this user.

acrobat_desktop_mode.description: Indicates whether the user is entitled to Acrobat Lite GenAI.

acrobat_pro.description: Indicates whether the user is entitled to download/install Acrobat Pro.

acrobat_std.description: Indicates whether the user is entitled to download/install Acrobat Standard.

combine_pdf_conversions.description: Number of combine operations that user is allowed to do

combine_pdf_documents.description: Maximum number of files that may be combined in one CombinePDF operation

combine_pdf_max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in kilobytes) of a file that can be accepted by CombinePDF

create_pdf_conversions.description: Number of documents that can be converted to PDF

create_pdf_max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in kilobytes) of a file that can be converted by CreatePDF

edit_pdf_max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in kilobytes) of a PDF that can be edited

edit_pdf_ops.description: Number of PDF documents that can be edited

export_pdf_conversions.description: Number of documents that can be exported from PDF

export_pdf_max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in kilobytes) of a file that can be exported by ExportPDF

ocr_pdf_conversions.description: Number of PDF documents that can have an OCR operation applied

ocr_pdf_max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in kilobytes) of a PDF that can be accepted for OCR

optimize_pdf_max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in kilobytes) of a PDF that can be accepted for optimization

optimize_pdf_ops.description: Number of PDF documents that can be optimized

organize_pdf_conversions.description: Number of organize operations that user is allowed to do

organize_pdf_documents.description: Maximum number of files that may be combined in one organize operation

organize_pdf_max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in kilobytes) of a file that can be accepted by organize

password_encrypt_max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in kilobytes) of a PDF that can be accepted for password encryption

password_encrypt_ops.description: Number of PDF documents that can be password encrypted

split_pdf_conversions.description: Number of PDF documents that can be splitted

split_pdf_max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in kilobytes) of a PDF that can be splitted

split_pdf_max_split_points.description: Maximum number of split points in input PDF file that will be allowed in one SplitPDF operation

esign_access.description:
* `no_access` - User does not have access to Echosign. This represents a new user to Echosign.
* `read_only` - User can read his contracts but cannot use any paid functionality like sending contracts. This represents a user who had Echosign at some point but has cancelled his subscription or allowed it to expire.
* `pro` - User has individual offering with no team management features.
* `team` - (tentative, pending review) User is part of a team where an admin can do basic customizations like branding.
* `enterprise` - User has extended team offering that enables creation of groups and allows the admin to configure an extensive list of settings per group.
* `global` - User has the most advanced team offering and provides access to advanced services like customized workflows.

legal_templates_access.description:
*  `true` - The user can create customisable legal agreements.
*  `false` - The user does not have access to create customisable legal agreements.

file_formats.description: List of supported file types that can be used to create a form

max_file_size.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes that can be used to create a form

max_num_of_fields.description: Maximum allowed number of fields per page

max_num_of_pages.description: Maximum allowed number of pages in PDF that can be used to create a form

access.description: If false, then the user does not have access to any PDF services. If true, then the user has access to some set of PDF services. Use other limits APIs to confirm which specific services.  e.g. /limits/conversions

review_count.description: A value of -1 Indicates that the user has unlimited access. A value of 0 Indicates that the user has no access.

can_custom_brand.description: Users who have purchased a subscription to the service can add custom branding to the shared files recipients page.

can_send_av.description:
Users who have purchased a subscription to the service can send audio or video files to recipients.
If this limit is false, a parcel created that includes audio or video files will fail with an error from the API request.

can_send_secure_link.description: Users who have purchased a subscription to the service can create and send private sharing links within an organisation.

can_send_to_individuals.description:
Users who have purchased a subscription to the service can have custom e-mails sent to recipients. Free users can generate only a single public url that they can paste into an e-mail or post on discussion boards.
If this limit is `false`, a parcel created that includes recipients other than the constant `PARCEL_PUBLIC_SHARING` will result in an error from the API request.

max_daily_send.description: The maximum number of emails the user can send in a day through the Send & Track service. This is based on the user's subscription and will initially be set to 50 for free users and 2500 for paid users. This setting is intended to replace the can_send_to_individuals setting, which will eventually be removed.

max_send_recipients.description: The maximum number of recipients that can be added to an individual parcel. This is based on the user's subscription and will initially be set to 10 for free users and 250 for paid users.

storage_quota.description: The user storage quota in GB.

storage_remaining.description: Space remaining in the user quota in GB (storage_quota - storage_used).

storage_slop.description: The user storage slop in GB.

storage_used.description: Storage charged against the user quota in GB.

max_number_files.description: Maximum number of files supported by the operation, if applicable

quota_details.description: Adjacent to remaining, represents quota details including next available and applicable frequency per verb, operation level or uber level.

frequency.description: the frequency at which quota refreshes. Value will be -1 when frequency is not applicable, like when user has unlimited transactions.

next_available.description: tells in seconds when next transactions will become available. Value will be -1 if transactions are still remaining for the the user.

remaining.description: tells how many transactions are remaining for the verb. 0 means none remaining, positive integer tells the count that are remaining, -1 means unlimited transactions remaining.

frequency.description: the frequency at which quota refreshes. Value will be -1 when frequency is not applicable, like when user has unlimited transactions.

next_available.description: tells in seconds when next transactions will become available. Value will be -1 if transactions are still remaining for the the user.

remaining.description: tells how many transactions are remaining for the verb. 0 means none remaining, positive integer tells the count that are remaining, -1 means unlimited transactions remaining.

acroprefs.description: user preference to sync his acrobat  preferences

genai.description: user preference related to genAI feature

dc_consent.description: provides essential information about user consent

latest version.description: version of the latest consent needed

status.description: indicates the current status of user consent

application_url.description: A link to a user experience that invokes the rule.

authorization_rules.description: Auth rules for making the access requests for various apps.

rule_id.description: Rule id to initiate request access workflow

licenses_available.description: If user posses licenses in context of app onboarded on access platform.

request_access_enabled.description: If the org-admin has enabled request access workflow for the users.

encryption_key_status.description: An enum indicating shared cloud encryption key status. The value could be either `enabled` or `disabled`.

region.description: an enum indicating region for document cloud data storage. Currently, its value could be one of `US`, `EU`, or `AP`.

billing_term.description: This value will not be available for document cloud offerings sold to team (CCT) and enterprise (CCE) subscriptions.

biz_source.description: The business source associated with this product purchase.

level.description: The service level.  All paid products have only a 'Basic' service level.

status.description: Account status.  Any status other than `Active` indicates that services are not available to this account.

sub_ref.description: A UUID value that allows this product to be correlated to the Adobe store API values. This will be NULL for document cloud offerings sold to team (CCT) and enterprise (CCE) subscriptions as these users are entitled by an admin and do not have subscription record associated with them.

subscription_params.description: Map of additional params present for this subscription, if any.

mandatory.description: 'true' if showing the upsell is mandatory and 'false' otherwise. For purchases, there are locations where showing multiple purchase options are mandatory. This flag will be true for those geos.

purchase_sku.description: The purchase sku number using which a user could get to the given entitlement. his field is available for both purchase and upgrade as there were use cases where upgrade was invoked with a purchase sku and clients need to translate from a purchase sku to an upgrade sku..

sitecatalyst_plan_code.description:
This is the string that will be sent to sitecatalyst with the purchase/upgrade event.
-> Refer to the "In-app upgrades" section of the SiteCatalyst Instrumentation - Plan Info wiki to get the analytics name for upgrades
-> Refer to the "" row in the "Anyware cart instrumentation" section of SiteCatalyst Instrumentation - Page Name and Custom Variables to get the analytics name for purchases.

subscription_name.description: Additional subscriptions may be added in the future.

upgrade_sku.description: The upgrade sku number for this user for the given entitlement. This field is an empty string when upsell_type is purchase.

url.description: URL which can be used by the client to invoke the upgrade or purchase workflow. Clients already running in the app may need to process the URL to navigate without reloading the app.
